description: Chapter 838's own museum page states this aircraft was used by the SC Johnson company as a marketing vehicle and was flown by company pilot Ed Hedeen on 12000-mile liquid-wax sales tours in 1929 and 1931; no registration is offered by the chapter and I could not source one independently so tail_number is blank
museum_name: Southeastern Wisconsin Aviation Museum / EAA Chapter 838

description: Gift to the museum from Dr R C Feulner of Oconomowoc Wisconsin; presented as a hands-on educational exhibit that visitors may sit in; manufacturer given as Denney which is the Kitfox II kit manufacturer of that period
museum_name: Southeastern Wisconsin Aviation Museum / EAA Chapter 838

description: Chapter restoration project being converted from PA-22 Tri-Pacer to PA-20 Pacer configuration; airframe stripped and inspected corrosion treated nose wheel removed and conventional gear welded on new panel and firewall fabricated; museum page still describes a maiden flight roughly two years out so the page text may itself be several years stale
museum_name: Southeastern Wisconsin Aviation Museum / EAA Chapter 838
